help.howitworks.switching_service_source.backTranslation: While a download is paused: choosing another source for a file that has already started downloading is accepted and saved, but nothing starts. A file that never started has nothing to hand over, so its new source takes effect directly when it starts. Choosing a Service while paused has the same effect as described above, except the download stays paused: a service that can take over the current link takes over immediately (the logo shows that service), while a service that must first prepare a copy shows Preparing… and only takes over after you resume the download. help.howitworks.backup_torrents.each_deb.backTranslation: Every debrid service has a Prepare backup torrents switch. When on, that service also adds torrents that are being delivered by other services, so that it can take over when needed; when you switch a download to another service, the torrent it had already started is kept as a backup instead of being removed. Turn this switch off to keep that service's slots for its own downloads: its backup torrents are then removed. Your saved choice is kept.

help.settings.users_access.user_accounts.backTranslation: User accounts lists each person with their role, sign-in method and whether the account is enabled. Add local account creates an account that uses a username and password. A role changed in Edit user takes effect immediately: pages the user already has open reload with the new role, without signing them out. Everyone has a DebridPulse username, separate from their display name: an OIDC account's username is taken from its first sign-in, and is also used for local password sign-in; the pencil icon next to the username in the Edit user title changes the username and keeps any stored password. Click an account's name to see its details and activity, where you can also withdraw an individual unfinished request. Disable and Remove first show how many unfinished download requests the account has; these requests are withdrawn, transfers that others also requested continue, and completed downloads are never affected. Disabling also ends all of the account's sign-in sessions and deactivates its tokens; removing keeps the account's history and deletes its own notification settings. A removed OIDC sign-in that appears again gets a new account, which stays disabled until you enable it. Merge combines two or more accounts into the one you choose to keep; two accounts sharing the same verified email address are flagged, but only performing a merge combines them. DebridPulse always keeps at least one usable administrator, and you cannot change your own role or disable your own account.

After selecting a backup, you can Save backup (download a copy), Restore backup or Remove it; Add backup first checks the saved copy, then uploads it. Restoring pauses processing, creates a safety backup of the current state, checks the selected backup again, replaces the current database and settings, and then restarts DebridPulse's services. If the check fails, nothing is changed, and every pause set by you or an *arr client is returned to how it was.

help.settings.data_maintenance.backups_r.backTranslation: Backups & Retention: scheduled backups to the Backup folder (on by default), with Backup interval, Backup retention and Maximum backups kept under Other backup and retention settings; a backup is removed when it is too old or no longer among the newest backups you keep. The same section also sets how often Statistics snapshots are created and how long they are kept: a statistics snapshot is a record of the previous 24 hours of activity saved in DebridPulse's database. Snapshots are not reports, are not sent anywhere, and currently cannot be viewed in the interface. Back up now creates a backup immediately (available only when backups are enabled).

help.settings.data_maintenance.database_.backTranslation: Database reset controls: turn on Allow database reset, press Reset database, enter {literal}, then press Wipe database. This clears all downloads with their requests and history, events and statistics snapshots. Accounts, passwords, OIDC links, API tokens, personal notification settings and all settings are kept. DebridPulse always creates a safety backup first, and stops if that backup fails. During the reset it stops running downloads and pauses processing, then restores the previous pause state afterwards. Completed files already in the download folder are not deleted.

help.trouble.before_changing_anything.av.backTranslation: Do not remove a download just to clear an error: DebridPulse keeps its source and history so it can retry or recover. If you need help, the Transfer trace log in Details (administrators only) can save a record that contains no passwords or private-link details. Read the record before sharing it, and never share API keys, tokens or links containing passwords.

Do not remove a download just to clear an error: DebridPulse keeps its source and history so it can be retried or recovered. If a problem needs investigating, an administrator can save that download's Transfer trace log for submitting a bug report.
